# Hybrid lighting reference fixtures

Synthetic inputs for `test/hybrid_reference_test.cpp`, which drives the C++ transliteration of the hybrid
WGSL (`Source/engine/render/hybrid_reference.cpp`) as the executable golden for
`Source/engine/render/webgpu_shaders.hpp`. Both files are generated by the script at the end of this
README (run it from the repository root: `python3 gen.py test/fixtures/hybrid`); the tests assert the
cells and pixels described below, so regenerate rather than hand-edit.

## volume_synthetic.bin

112 x 112 little-endian `u32` cells, index `y * 112 + x`, packed as in `tile_geometry::volume`:
bits 0-7 heightPx, 8 FaceSW, 9 FaceSE, 10 BlockLight, 11 Solid, 12 Visible, 13 Explored, 14 Arch,
15 DoorOpen, 16 Blended, 17-20 dLight, 21-27 lintelPx / 2. Every cell defaults to an explored, visible
floor with dLight 0 (fully lit); `heightPixelsPerWorldUnit` is 32 in the tests, so 64 px = 2 units.

Standalone visibility scene (no planes needed):

| cell | contents | used by |
|---|---|---|
| (5,5) | wall, both faces, BlockLight, height 64 px (2 units) | wall-behind test over all 32 SW columns, skip semantics, z 3 passes |
| (5,9) | wall, height 160 px (5 units) | z 3 blocked |
| (20,20) | walkable arch: Arch, lintel 96 px (3 units), height 160 px, BlockLight clear | passes under the lintel, blocks above it |
| (30,30) | closed door: BlockLight, height 64 px | door toggle (the test clears BlockLight on a copy) |
| (34,30) | open door: DoorOpen, BlockLight clear, height 64 px | door toggle, Volume debug tint |
| (40,40) | unexplored, BlockLight + Arch + Solid, height 32 px, lintel 32 px | blocks regardless of height, never exposes the arch |
| (44,40) | unexplored, no BlockLight | passes, ambient 0, magenta in the Volume view |
| (50..65, 50) | dLight gradient `x - 50` (0..15); (66,50) stays dLight 0 | ambient, clamp, gate; a dLight 15 cell next to a lit one |

Planes scene (the cells the planes below project onto; screen origin (0, -256), so the top vertex of
cell (tx, ty) is at screen `(32 (tx - ty), 16 (tx + ty) - 256)` and the diamond spans 64 x 32 px with
its base row 31 rows below the top vertex):

| cell | top vertex | contents |
|---|---|---|
| (9,8) | (32, 16), base row 47 | foot-table wall, both faces, height 64 px |
| (10,7) | (96, 16), base row 47 | pillar (BlockLight, no faces, 32 px): WallTop pixels |
| (11,8) | (96, 48), base row 79 | walkable arch, lintel 96 px, height 160 px: WallLeft pixels with B = tile base |
| (11,9) | (64, 64) | dLight 15 (fully dark) under the right half of the card |
| (9,9) (10,9) (9,10) (10,10) (11,10) | | dLight 14 room around the blended wall |
| (8,7) | (32, -16) | unexplored: its floor pixels at rows 0..15 are the Volume-view leak detector |

## planes_synthetic.bin

Header `"HYBP"`, then little-endian `u16` pitch (128), width (128), height (96), viewportHeight (80);
then three `pitch * height` byte planes: A (aux: `kind << 5 | normal`), B (base row of the anchor,
`& 0xFF`), index (`(x * 7 + y * 13) & 255`, a palette index per pixel). Painter's order, later
entries overwrite earlier ones:

1. everything Unlit; rows 0..79 Floor (aux 32, B 0); rows 80..95 stay Unlit (below the viewport)
2. wall (9,8): SW face x = c for c in 0..31, foot `(31 - c) / 2`, rows `47 - foot - h` for h in 0..31,
   aux WallLeft|1 (65), B = `47 - foot`; SE face x = c for c in 32..63, foot `c / 2`, aux WallRight|2 (98)
3. pillar (10,7): x 64..127, rows 16..47, aux WallTop|0 (224), B = 47 (base row; h = 0 on row 47)
4. arch (11,8): x 96..127, rows 48..79, aux WallLeft|1 (65), B = 79 (tile base, foot None)
5. blended wall (10,9): SW face x = c for c in 0..31, foot `(31 - c) / 2`, rows `79 - foot - h` for h in
   0..15, aux WallBlended|1 (193), B = `79 - foot`
6. card 16 x 32: x 42..57, feet row 71, rows 40..71, aux Card|3 (131), B = 71; its ground straddles
   (10,9) (x <= 49) and (11,9) (x >= 50)
7. CardEmissive: x 100..111, rows 0..11 (aux 160)
8. Unlit inside the viewport (UI stamp): x 112..127, rows 0..15 (aux 0)
9. plane-B wrap guard: x 2..3, rows 74..75, aux WallLeft|1 with B = `(y + 250) & 255` so h = 250

Mask texel (mx, my) at maskScale 2 reads output pixel (2 mx + 1, 2 my + 1); the tests name texels by
that rule (e.g. mask (5, 15) is wall pixel (11, 31), h = 6).

## Generator

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generates test/fixtures/hybrid/{volume_synthetic.bin,planes_synthetic.bin} (see README.md there)."""
import struct
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# ---- volume (packed layout), 112 x 112 little-endian u32, index = y * 112 + x ----
W = H = 112
FACE_SW, FACE_SE, BLOCK, SOLID, VISIBLE, EXPLORED, ARCH, DOOR_OPEN = (1 << 8, 1 << 9, 1 << 10, 1 << 11, 1 << 12, 1 << 13, 1 << 14, 1 << 15)
def cell(height=0, flags=0, dlight=0, lintel_px=0, explored=True):
    v = (height & 0xFF) | flags | ((dlight & 15) << 17) | (((lintel_px // 2) & 127) << 21)
    if explored:
        v |= EXPLORED | VISIBLE
    return v
WALL = FACE_SW | FACE_SE | BLOCK | SOLID
vol = [cell() for _ in range(W * H)]
def setc(x, y, v):
    vol[y * W + x] = v
# standalone visibility scene
setc(5, 5, cell(64, WALL))                           # wall of height 2 units
setc(5, 9, cell(160, WALL))                          # wall of height 5 units
setc(20, 20, cell(160, ARCH, lintel_px=96))          # walkable arch: lintel 3 units, BlockLight clear
setc(30, 30, cell(64, BLOCK | SOLID))                # door, closed
setc(34, 30, cell(64, DOOR_OPEN))                    # door, open (BlockLight clear)
setc(40, 40, cell(32, BLOCK | ARCH | SOLID, lintel_px=32, explored=False))  # unexplored + BlockLight (+ hidden arch)
setc(44, 40, cell(0, 0, explored=False))             # unexplored, no BlockLight
for x in range(50, 66):
    setc(x, 50, cell(dlight=x - 50))                 # dLight gradient 0..15; (66,50) stays dLight 0
# planes scene (cells visible through planes_synthetic.bin, origin (0, -256))
setc(9, 8, cell(64, WALL))                           # foot-table wall, both faces
setc(10, 7, cell(32, BLOCK | SOLID))                 # pillar (WallTop pixels)
setc(11, 8, cell(160, ARCH, lintel_px=96))           # arch (WallLeft pixels with B = tile base)
setc(11, 9, cell(dlight=15))                         # fully dark cell under half of the card
for (x, y) in [(9, 9), (10, 9), (9, 10), (10, 10), (11, 10)]:
    setc(x, y, cell(dlight=14))                      # dLight-14 room around the blended wall
setc(8, 7, cell(0, 0, explored=False))               # unexplored cell whose floor pixels are in the viewport (debug view 5 leak detector)

# ---- planes: magic "HYBP", u16 pitch, u16 width, u16 height, u16 viewportHeight, then aux, base, index (pitch * height each) ----
PW, PH, PITCH, VIEWPORT = 128, 96, 128, 80
K_UNLIT, K_FLOOR, K_WALL_L, K_WALL_R, K_CARD, K_CARD_EMISSIVE, K_WALL_BLENDED, K_WALL_TOP = range(8)
def aux(kind, normal=0):
    return (kind << 5) | normal
A = bytearray(PITCH * PH)
B = bytearray(PITCH * PH)
I = bytearray(PITCH * PH)
def put(x, y, a, b):
    if 0 <= x < PW and 0 <= y < PH:
        A[y * PITCH + x] = a
        B[y * PITCH + x] = b
for y in range(PH):
    for x in range(PW):
        I[y * PITCH + x] = (x * 7 + y * 13) & 255
        if y < VIEWPORT:
            put(x, y, aux(K_FLOOR, 0), 0)
def wall_faces(left_x, base_row, kind_l, kind_r, hmax):
    for c in range(32):                               # SW face, foot (31 - c) / 2
        foot = (31 - c) // 2
        for h in range(hmax + 1):
            put(left_x + c, base_row - foot - h, aux(kind_l, 1), (base_row - foot) & 255)
    for c in range(32, 64):                           # SE face, foot c / 2
        foot = c // 2
        for h in range(hmax + 1):
            put(left_x + c, base_row - foot - h, aux(kind_r, 2), (base_row - foot) & 255)
wall_faces(0, 47, K_WALL_L, K_WALL_R, 31)             # cell (9,8): top vertex (32,16), base row 47
for y in range(16, 48):                               # cell (10,7) pillar: x 64..127, base row 47, WallTop, B = 47
    for x in range(64, 128):
        put(x, y, aux(K_WALL_TOP, 0), 47)
for y in range(48, 80):                               # cell (11,8) arch: right half x 96..127, B = base row 79
    for x in range(96, 128):
        put(x, y, aux(K_WALL_L, 1), 79)
for c in range(32):                                   # cell (10,9) blended wall SW face: base row 79, h 0..15
    foot = (31 - c) // 2
    for h in range(16):
        put(c, 79 - foot - h, aux(K_WALL_BLENDED, 1), (79 - foot) & 255)
for h in range(32):                                   # card 16 x 32, feet row 71, x 42..57: straddles (10,9) | (11,9)
    for x in range(42, 58):
        put(x, 71 - h, aux(K_CARD, 3), 71)
for y in range(0, 12):                                # CardEmissive region
    for x in range(100, 112):
        put(x, y, aux(K_CARD_EMISSIVE, 0), 0)
for y in range(0, 16):                                # Unlit (UI-stamped) region inside the viewport
    for x in range(112, 128):
        put(x, y, aux(K_UNLIT, 0), 0)
for y in (74, 75):                                    # wall texels with h = 250 (plane-B wrap guard)
    for x in (2, 3):
        put(x, y, aux(K_WALL_L, 1), (y + 250) & 255)

out = Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else Path("test/fixtures/hybrid")
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(out / "volume_synthetic.bin").write_bytes(struct.pack("<%dI" % (W * H), *vol))
(out / "planes_synthetic.bin").write_bytes(b"HYBP" + struct.pack("<HHHH", PITCH, PW, PH, VIEWPORT) + bytes(A) + bytes(B) + bytes(I))
print("wrote", out / "volume_synthetic.bin", W * H * 4, "bytes;", out / "planes_synthetic.bin", 12 + 3 * PITCH * PH, "bytes")
```
